title: coelogyne infernalis
intro: Coelogyne infernalis, commonly known as the Hell's Coelogyne orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne infernalis include its ability to modulate immune response, exhibit antioxidant activity, and potentially exert sedative effects. Research has identified the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
